SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
〔印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE A.S.B. 8/25 15/10 41〕

Rel. Special Branch. XXXXX File No. ____ Date October 14, 1941.

SUBJECT: D.S.I. Cornwall - Change of address

With effect from Wednesday October 15th, 1941
my address will be 119R/18 Bubbling Well Road. As
soon as I receive my new telephone number from the
Telephone Company I will notify C.C.R..

FILE
〔批：14.10.41 By 14/10〕

〔印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 14 OCT 1941〕

A. C. (Special Branch).

H.C. Cornwall
D. S. I.

报告
〔印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 A.S.B. 8/25 15/10 41〕

致：特别处。XXXXX 档案号 ____ 日期：1941年10月14日。

主题：副巡官康沃尔（Cornwall）——变更住址

自1941年10月15日（星期三）起，
本人的住址将改为静安寺路119R/18号。一旦
从电话公司获知新的电话号码，本人将通知中央无线电室（C.C.R.）。

归档
〔批注：1941年10月14日 由 14/10〕

〔印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处 1941年10月14日〕

副巡官

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
No. S. B. D. 8/25
Date March 19 1940
Date 19/3/40

Subject (in full) Removal of D. S. Yamashita's address.

Made by D. S. Yamashita Forwarded by Superintendent Mason.

On March 16, 1940, the undersigned removed
from Hongkew Station police quarters to leased
police quarters at Lane 156, House 8, Quinsan Road.

D. S. Yamashita

D. C. (Special Branch).
